We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Lead Engineer – Thales (Cybersecurity & HSM Solutions) to join our project team in Riyadh. In this role, you will lead the architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation of enterprise-grade data protection, hardware security modules (HSMs), and key management systems using Thales technologies.

• Architecture & Framework Integration: Architect and deploy enterprise-wide data encryption and access control frameworks, integrating Thales HSMs with databases (Oracle/MS SQL TDE), web servers (IIS, WebLogic, Tomcat), PAM, and PKI environments.
• HSM & CipherTrust Management: Manage and maintain Thales Luna, payShield, and CipherTrust Manager clusters; handle patch management, software updates, and overall appliance health with zero downtime.
• Audits & Security Compliance: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability assessments, and risk reviews. Ensure compliance with data security and privacy regulations (PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA).

• Automation & Maintenance: Automate key-lifecycle tasks (key rotation, backups, provisioning, and retirement) using Ansible and REST APIs.
• Vendor & Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with cross-functional IT/Risk teams and third-party vendors to assess security gaps, integrate controls, and validate external SLAs.

• Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in Cybersecurity, specializing in Data Protection, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), and Key Management.

• In-depth hands-on experience with Thales Luna HSM, payShield, and CipherTrust Data Security Platform.
